selection.verdict: NO VIABLE POINT. No stitch cell is both >= 1.25x faster end-to-end than the large model and more accurate than the small model at 95% confidence. The small model scores 77.1% and already runs 4.83x faster end-to-end than large. Best stitch accuracy was 60.0% [43.6%-74.4%] at L18->L20 (warm, 1.51x end-to-end). The small model dominates every point on both axes; running it directly is the better trade.
